headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily, but Zalora's 4.9 looks store-wide rather than per product, so Morfosia's 4.9 from 1,095 Tokopedia ratings is the safer proof point.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs each brand's last snapshot and 11 Nov: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32, Mykonos 4.26, Onix 4.17, HMNS 4.15. No brand moved ±0.03. SAFF shows 1,746 reviews; Las Pozas reads 91 again, not 92.
Correction: Zalora shows 4.9 from about 1,424 reviews on S.O.T.B, Irai Leima and Xocolatl alike, so it looks store-wide. The S.O.T.B '4.9 vs 4.1' gap is not a like-for-like comparison.
Morfosia has product-level proof on SAFF's official Tokopedia store: 4.9 from 1,095 ratings, with only 1.1% at 1–2 stars.
Share gap: Compas Q2 2026 Shopee data ranks SAFF 4th at 3.52%, vs Mykonos 6.75% and HMNS 5.06%.
Unofficial selling goes beyond Tokopedia decants: an individual eBay seller lists SAFF 35 ml at US$75 plus US$18 shipping, with no authorisation shown.

recommendations.text: Report unverified SAFF resellers and decant shops on Tokopedia and eBay, and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
Stop citing Zalora's 4.9 as a score for one scent; use product-level proof such as Morfosia's 4.9 from 1,095 Tokopedia ratings in ads and product pages.
Push official minis and travel sizes (Maleali 5 ml Rp29.5k, Morfosia 8 ml Rp89k at Watsons) as the safe trial option, and answer the 'bottle not travel-friendly' complaint in product copy.
Read S.O.T.B's low-star Female Daily reviews (4.1 from 586, SAFF's most-reviewed scent) and fix the top complaint in copy or product.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
